title: Claude Code plugin.json
description: Schema for a plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest. Field set follows https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference.md — covers the fields this marketplace's tooling relies on plus the documented component fields its plugins use (userConfig, workflows, outputStyles, defaultEnabled, settings, lspServers, dependencies objects); unknown extra fields are tolerated for forward-compatibility.

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier, matches the plugin's directory name. Max 42 characters so the derived GitHub label "plugin: <name>" stays within GitHub's 50-character limit (ADR-0004).

version.description: Required by this repo (ADR-0003): explicit semver without build metadata. Bump on every user-facing change; CI tags {name}--v{version} on merge.

description.description: Required by this repo's own convention (stricter than upstream) so the generated marketplace catalog always has a description.

dependencies.description: Other plugins this plugin requires, by name or with a semver constraint (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-dependencies).

metadata.description: Free-form object Claude Code never reads (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference, plugin manifest schema), so editing it is not a runtime change (METADATA_KEYS, ADR-0003). This repo requires `marketplace` for catalog fields plugin.json itself cannot carry; npm run generate copies them into the plugin's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json entry.

marketplace.description: Copied into the marketplace entry's `category` and `tags` (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces, plugin entries).

userConfig.description: Values Claude Code asks the user for when the plugin is enabled (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference#user-configuration). Upstream shape: schemas/claude-code/plugin-manifest.schema.json#/definitions/userConfig.

workflows.description: Workflow script files or directories; replaces the default workflows/.

outputStyles.description: Output style files or directories; replaces the default output-styles/.

defaultEnabled.description: Whether the plugin starts enabled when the user has not set a state. Default true.

settings.description: Defaults applied while enabled; only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine` are supported.

lspServers.description: LSP server configs, or a path to .lsp.json.

marketplaceCategory.description: The one list of catalog categories this marketplace allows; marketplace.schema.json references it. A curated subset of the categories the official Anthropic marketplace (anthropics/claude-plugins-official) uses, checked 2026-09-19; location, math, and migration are left out as outside this marketplace's scope. Add a value here, never in a plugin.

marketplaceTags.description: Lowercase kebab-case search tags for the marketplace entry.
